visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vivid extreme close-up of a single, glossy, golden-brown shrimp ball held vertically by wooden chopsticks. The background is a soft-focus kitchen setting with neutral tones. White bold captions appear at the top. (2) A male chef wearing a professional white chef's uniform with pink floral sleeve accents holds a raw, de-veined shrimp toward the camera. He is in a brightly lit studio kitchen with a white brick wall background. (3) A top-down shot shows a glass bowl containing ten raw shrimps. Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves add salt, white pepper, rice wine, a bright yellow egg yolk, starch, scallion segments, and ginger slices. A detailed ingredient list is overlaid on the left. (4) The chef stands in a medium shot, speaking and gesturing with his hands to explain the process. The lighting is even and bright, highlighting his facial expressions and professional attire. (5) A top-down view shows the preparation of batter; 120g of flour, an egg, and water from a white electric kettle are poured into a glass bowl and whisked vigorously until a smooth yellow paste forms. (6) The chef gestures again before the scene cuts to a black frying pan on a portable stove. Battered shrimps are dropped into hot oil, bubbling vigorously. A metal slotted spoon is used to turn them until they turn golden. (7) Chopped white onions and vibrant red, yellow, and green bell peppers are placed in a metal strainer and briefly submerged in the hot frying oil. The scene transitions to a clean black pan where oil, minced ginger, and garlic are sautéed. (8) Ketchup, sugar, vinegar, and other liquid seasonings are added to the pan to create a thick red sauce. The previously fried shrimps are poured into the bubbling sauce and tossed with a wooden spatula until each piece is thoroughly and evenly coated. (9) Finally, chopped green scallions and a drizzle of sesame oil are added. The video concludes with a close-up of a perfectly glazed shrimp ball being lifted by chopsticks, appearing highly appetising and textured.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming combined with a steady, rhythmic drum beat starts immediately. A male voice with high energy and a friendly, instructional tone introduces the dish. The audio has a bright spectral weight and high clarity typical of studio recordings. (2) The narrator explains the ingredient preparation. There is a faint sound of liquid being poured followed by the rhythmic clinking of a whisk against a glass bowl as the batter is mixed. The music maintains a consistent tempo around 128 BPM. (3) A distinct 'click' sound occurs as an electric kettle is moved. The narrator's speech rate is moderately fast but very well-articulated. There is no background noise other than the intended instructional sounds and the BGM. (4) A loud, broadband sizzling sound of frying oil triggers a new phase. The sound is rich in transients as battered shrimps hit the oil. The narrator continues speaking over the sizzling, which is balanced well in the mix. (5) The sound of metal kitchen utensils clinking against the pan is audible as vegetables are flash-fried. The narrator’s tone remains enthusiastic. Subtle post-production 'pop' sound effects accentuate the appearance of text on screen. (6) The sizzling subsides into a lower-frequency bubbling sound as the sauce is prepared in a pan. The sound of a wooden spatula scraping the pan bottom is clear. The music and speech overlap continuously throughout the remainder of the clip. (7) The narrator delivers a final enthusiastic wrap-up. The acoustic guitar BGM swells slightly before a hard cut at the very end of the video track.
